messages:
ana: quick follow-up from the quant probe convo 1: I think we should split heavy quality checks out of the runtime. runtime only emits tiny signals; a separate profile service does shadow evals and decisions.

mike: total agree. runtime touching full-quality checks will spike p95.

sophia: flow idea: runtime tags sampled requests with probe_id + minimal metrics (latency_ms, token_entropy_est). collector reads local cache, scrubs PII, sends to shadow-eval queue. shadow-eval computes degradation_score and posts back.

tony: sampling cost is real. propose default sample_rate=0.001 globally, higher for canaries. need scrubbers + ephemeral storage.

ana: pseudoconfig: {"quant_probe_enabled": true, "sample_rate": 0.001, "scrub_mode": "scrub-pii", "eval_target": "shadow-eval-prod", "rollback_threshold": 0.12}

mike: runtime API change: optional probe_id in request metadata + enum probe_reason (canary|random|scheduled). backwards compatible.

sophia: policy: runtime fallbacks (e.g., fp8->int8->int4) should be perf-first for latency-critical endpoints but respect a quality_guard_window: if recent probe_degradation_rate > threshold, prefer safer profile. profile-service exposes allowed cascade per endpoint.

tony: make fallback precedence configurable per endpoint, default {fp8,int8,int4,fp16}. add metric probe_ack_rate; alert if <80% for 10m.

mike: for private/dedicated, allow customer-owned shadow-eval endpoint and require encryption-at-rest for artifacts.

deploy-bot: probe-gate v0.1 pushed to staging (ana/mike/sophia canary) :rocket:

sophia: i'll draft degscore spec (embedding distance + task metrics + hallucination heuristics) and a tiny harness.
mike: i'll open RFC for ops split + runtime api change and write an ops runbook snippet.

ana: agreed next steps: RFC + degscore spec + runbook. :thumbsup:
